name: 25O-NBOMe
summary: 25O-NBOMe, also known as 2,4,5-TMPEA-NBOMe or as N-(2-methoxybenzyl)-2,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 25-NB (NBOMe) families. It is the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) derivative of 2C-O (2,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine).

pharmacology.text: 25O-NBOMe, also known as 2,4,5-TMPEA-NBOMe or as N-(2-methoxybenzyl)-2,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and 25-NB (NBOMe) families. The drug is known to act as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist, with an EC50 of 1.02 to 7.24 nM and an Emax of 57 to 129%.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
